text_block_list.text:
Back at the training camp lodge after a 
whole year. Our "Summer Camp" begins here 
once again this year.

Looking around, media restrictions seemed 
more relaxed than last time, and members 
of the press could be seen here and there.
More than that, however—

text_block_list.name: Devoted Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Briaaaan, don't let some injury beat 
you--!

text_block_list.name: Devoted Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"We're rooting for you! We can't wait to 
see the monster make her comeback!"

Narita Brian's "cheering squad" rushed 
over, carrying a massive banner.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently, they even got permission from 
the academy, with the promise that they 
won't get in the students' way."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The girl sitting next to me on the bus was 
saying, 'Brian-san is just in a league of 
her own~'
choice_data_list: She's in a league of her own...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
――Ah. Shall I try guessing what you're 
thinking, Trainer? It's been a while.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
If you dwell too much on how different you 
two are, you won't be able to fire 
yourself up as her rival, y'know~

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Is that not right?
choice_data_list:
Though you're not the type to end up like 
that

But you're not the type to end up like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Yes. Otherwise, I wouldn't say I 
"yearn" for it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Her back is there, on the very same turf. 
That's why my heart burns with passion."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—I told myself I'd overtake that light. 
That I wanted to win.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Well then, shall we get going too? ♪
choice_data_list:
I won't let them beat me—time to train 
hard!
Let's train hard and not be outdone!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ We'll give it 100%—no, 120% of 
everything we've got!

And having finished our preparations with 
Sakura Laurel, we headed toward the beach—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Wah. Looks like they beat us to it.

Narita Brian seemed to have finished her 
warm-up and was just about to start 
running right then.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
choice_data_list:
If you're curious, why don't we watch for 
a bit before starting?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Then if you don't mind, I'll take you up 
on that.

Besides ourselves, a crowd of what 
appeared to be Narita Brian's fans had 
gathered on the beach.

Every single one of them holds their 
breath and watches her run so as not to 
disturb her concentration. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: HRAAAAAHHHH!!
(Bz-bz-bz-bzz... t!)

Narita Brian races across the sand. 
Watching her run, the crowd gathered on 
the beach—

text_block_list.name: Person on the Beach A
text_block_list.text:
Insane! Brian is, like, so friggin' 
awesome!!

text_block_list.name: Person on the Beach B
text_block_list.text:
Showing that kind of intensity right after 
coming back... Once she gets back into top 
form, she'll easily surpass her run in the 
Hanshin Daishoten!!

text_block_list.name: Person on the Beach B
text_block_list.text: Brian really is the strongest!

As if that momentary silence had been a 
lie, the beach was once again bursting 
with lively energy.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
choice_data_list: That was an amazing run, as always.
That was an amazing run, as always.

text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help but give an honest 
reaction. Even though she was just warming 
up, that run of hers carried a truly 
intimidating aura.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ... Something feels... weird...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...! Ah, no— it shouldn't be anything, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer. Would you like to come 
watch again sometime this summer? 
Brian-chan, that is."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Of course, after I finish my training. 
Um...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...There's something I'm a bit curious 
about.

Sakura Laurel's words seemed laden with 
hidden meaning. Yet, as if lacking 
certainty, her true intentions remained 
kept as a secret.
...Not just yet.
